title: Does grokking generalize across group structure? A modular-arithmetic ablation of the Fourier-multiplication finding

original_idea.body:
# Grokking Across Group Structure

Train tiny transformer on various algebraic tasks (cyclic, multiplication, symmetric groups); compare circuit structure and transition sharpness.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain to trustworthiness of mechanistic stories as alignment evidence but the safety link is broad.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Tiny transformer training plus FFT/representation analysis on non-abelian groups needs math sophistication; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused ablation across group types; multiple groups/analyses add breadth.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: toy models, one GPU; though grokking circuits are heavily studied.

low_compute.reasoning: Minutes per task on one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Grokking on non-abelian groups has some work but the cross-group mechanism comparison may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Group-theoretic grokking has some work; this systematic ablation may be partially open.
